uncited: **`valid_mask`**: An 8-bit bitmask where bit $i$ corresponds to child $i$.
A value of 1 means the child exists (is not empty), and 0 otherwise.
**`leaf_mask`**: An 8-bit bitmask where bit $i$ corresponds to child $i$.
A value of 1 means the child is a leaf node (has no further children), and 0 otherwise.
**`child_ptr`**: An array of eight 16-bit relative offsets, one per child.
If bit 15 is set, it indicates a far pointer, and the remaining 15 bits (masked) serve as an index to a far entry.
The far entry contains a 32-bit `far_ptr` with the actual offset.
**`far_ptr`**: A 32-bit absolute or relative pointer stored in a separate `CNode` entry (or dedicated array) when `child_ptr` indicates a far reference.
If `child_ptr[i] < _shortPtrTop`: the child is located at `base_address + child_ptr[i]`.

If `child_ptr[i] >= _shortPtrTop`: extract the index `idx = child_ptr[i] & (_shortPtrTop - 1)`, retrieve the `far_ptr` value from the indirection entry at `idx`, and locate the child at `base_address + far_ptr`.
- Relative offsets are limited to 15 bits for short pointers.
